English.Char_Desc_2000:
mpGrab is a free, friendly video downloader and converter for Windows by RockHouse. Paste a link, pick a format, done - powered by the actively maintained yt-dlp engine.
Features: - Search YouTube directly and queue results with thumbnails - Formats: Best quality, 1080p / 720p / 480p, MP3 192 kbit/s, M4A - Pause & resume - interrupted downloads continue without losing progress - Download history - finished downloads are remembered with one-click open-folder and re-download - Clear queue table - Portal, Title, Quality, Format and live progress for every item - Clean file names: Artist - Title with the thumbnail embedded as cover art - 13 interface languages: English, Deutsch, Turkish, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Dutch - Dark & light themes with four accent colors - persisted between runs - Clipboard monitoring, browser-cookie login for age-restricted videos, proxy support, system-tray minimize - In-app update notifications
mpGrab is a download manager for personal use. Please respect the rights of content creators and the terms of service of the platforms you download from.
